text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide claimed victory in the 
Japanese Derby. Yet the expression on her 
face was not one of jubilation, but of 
fear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
No matter how many calculations are made 
before the challenge, Narita Taishin and 
Winning Ticket surpass all expectations 
with an inexplicable "something else."

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Biwa Hayahide pondered what that 
"something" was. Surely, she lacked the 
"resolve to grow stronger" that the other 
two possessed.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Having reached that conclusion, Biwa 
Hayahide asked for high-intensity training 
to avoid losing to the two of them. All so 
she wouldn't taste defeat in her next 
goal, the Kikuka Sho.
